rights.title: Your rights for delays, cancellations and overbooking
rights.intro: EU Regulation EC 261/2004 protects passengers departing from an EU airport, or arriving in the EU on an EU airline.
rights.delayText: From 3 hours of arrival delay, you may be entitled to fixed compensation.
rights.cancelText: Unless notified at least 14 days ahead or due to extraordinary circumstances, cancellation entitles you to compensation.
rights.overbookingText: Involuntary denied boarding is compensated, regardless of delay.

scale.title: EC 261/2004 compensation scale
scale.intro: The amount depends on the flight distance:
scale.row2: €400 — flights of 1,500 to 3,500 km, and all intra-EU flights over 1,500 km
scale.reductionNote: A 50% reduction may apply to long-haul flights (> 3,500 km, outside the EU) with an arrival delay between 3 and 4 hours.

legal.draftNotice: Template document — to be reviewed by a lawyer before commercial launch.
legal.commissionClause: Air Assist charges a 30% commission (incl. tax) on compensation actually obtained. The passenger receives 70%. No fee is due without a win.
legal.withdrawalText: You have a 14-day withdrawal period. If you request immediate start of the service, you may owe for the service already performed if you withdraw.

footer.disclaimer: Air Assist is an intermediary; amounts shown are estimates.
